* Night - Differential of $15.00 per week for tour starting at 10:00 PM or later and ending prior to or at 7:00 AM.

**Morning/Afternoon - No differential except for tours beginning prior to 7:00 AM for which differential of $4.50 is applicable.

KEY: M/E - Morning Evening

M/ES - Morning Evening Short

A/E - Afternoon Evening

M/A - Morning Afternoon

A/ES - Afternoon Evening Short

E/NS - Evening Night Short

N - Night
